ResearchProjectDef.label: biomass disassembly
ResearchProjectDef.description: Placeholder. Unlocks the butcher table's "Harvest components" operation, which consumes a fresh human corpse and a picocluster to produce crystalline joints. Mutilating a body takes a heavy toll on the operator and sours others' opinion of them.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText:
You are now able to "produce" tenebral joints, which are essential for creating advanced Tenebral equipment. These superior components are harvested by applying a shot of picoclusters into a dead body, effectively extracting the necessary materials from the corpse.
It makes a gigantic mess and will not make people think of you any better - unless you have a matching precept.
Look up Butcher tables or spots for a helpful gizmo.
